item.title: Have You Seen This Duck?
item.description:
Small. Suspicious. Terribly sneaky.

The first duck appeared in my life with Fury Escape Captain’s arrival in Oslo. I did not expect this duck to stay in my life. It was supposed to go live in a random escape room in Oslo, and a certainly, definitely, absolutely not to continue haunting my days.

Expectations faced reality in a harsh game of wits and I ended up with a duck in my pocket. I gave it a name. I tried not enjoying its tiny company. I failed.
